changelog: Diagnosis (verified against the live server before any code changed, not guessed): both get_symbols and get_backtest_sessions ARE correctly registered and reachable on live -- curling both routes unauthenticated returns clean HTTP 200 JSON ({"error":"Not authenticated"}), not "Unknown action," which rules out the Chart-to-Backtesting rename breaking a route/controller name. Live's own version.json also confirms v3.20.1 (including last release's btApi() error-handling wrapper) is already deployed, ruling out a stale deploy too. The leading remaining explanation: this server moved to a new Hetzner VPS on 2026-09-24, one day before this ticket, and the backtest_sessions table + session_name column (migrations 2026_09_25_0001/0002) may not have been re-applied against the new database yet -- please confirm via migrate.php?mode=status.

Fix: v3.20.1's btApi() converted any failure into a generic "could not reach the server" message, which stopped the infinite spinner but threw away the one thing needed to diagnose it -- what the server actually sent back. btApi() no longer calls the shared api() helper; it does its own fetch(), always reads the raw response body as text first, and only then attempts JSON.parse -- a failure now shows the real HTTP status plus a snippet of the server's actual response text, not a guess. This never throws; every caller just checks .error.

Fix: the symbol dropdown's failure state now renders a Retry button (not just error text) that re-runs the load in place -- per the standing rule that a silent permanent spinner is a defect in itself, this is now structurally true regardless of what actually failed.

Rework: Saved Backtests is no longer a screen inside the Backtesting page -- it's its own sidebar entry, directly under Backtesting, with its own loading/error/empty states and a Retry button on failure. The New Backtest page now contains only the form; "View Backtests" navigates to the new page instead of switching screens in place.
New: Delete a saved backtest (delete_backtest_session) -- cascades to its pending orders and simulated trades via the existing ON DELETE CASCADE foreign keys, nothing left behind.

Presentation: Saved Backtests renders as a card grid -- name, symbol, timeframe, colour-coded status badge, equity, a real progress bar toward the profit target, created date, Resume/Review + Delete actions; empty state is a "Create your first backtest" button, not a bare loading message. The New Backtest form is now grouped into labelled sections (Session / Market & Data / Risk / Challenge Rules) at a centred 640px width instead of one long column. Fixed a real dark-theme bug in the replay window's New Order panel: its label/input/select elements had no override and were falling back to the app's global light-theme form styling (light background, dark text) against the panel's dark background -- exactly what "renders as unstyled stacked text" describes. Scoped dark-theme overrides added for .bt-side-panel specifically.

The collapsible sidebar (icon rail, hover tooltips, localStorage-persisted, chart resize() on toggle/window-resize) is unchanged and confirmed still correct on both the Backtesting and new Saved Backtests pages.
release_notes: No new migration in this release. If the Loading/blank-list symptom persists after this update, run migrate.php?mode=status on the live server first -- migrations 2026_09_25_0001_create_backtest_tables.sql and 2026_09_25_0002_add_backtest_session_name.sql (from v3.20.0/v3.20.1) need to have actually been applied against the NEW Hetzner database (migrated 2026-09-24) for get_backtest_sessions to work at all; if mode=status shows them pending, run mode=run. This release's improved btApi() will now show the real HTTP status and server response text in that failure case instead of a generic message, which should confirm this immediately either way.
